designationHistory.indexText: Aroostook National Wildlife Refuge (NWR or refuge), located in the northeast corner of Maine, was established in 1998, when 4,700 acres was transferred from the US Air Force to the U.S.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
